reasons.plausibility: Invoking differential thermal expansion as a driver of nano‐scale segregation is conceivable but not definitively established, so some mechanism details remain uncertain.
reasons.testability: They propose a clear experimental comparison (thermally cycled vs. untreated samples) with microscopy and mechanical tests; this should yield a reasonably decisive test of the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The unified explanation and straightforward test plan could be valuable to researchers seeking to reconcile multiple observed phenomena in HfNbTaTiZr alloys.
